description: Durable reconciliation ledger for the August 2026 supplier catalogue expansion. Tracks all supplier entries across six disposition states. Append-only governance evidence. The current provisional missing count is 349, an upper bound — not a confirmed unique-fragrance count (352 at the 2026-10-10 reconciliation and 351 after the first confirmed existing match are retained as history in countHistory).

governancePrinciples: The provisional missing count is currently 349 — an upper bound, not a confirmed total or unique-fragrance count. History: 352 at the 2026-10-10 reconciliation; 351 after the LADIES-277 existing match; 349 after the LADIES-108 existing match and the LADIES-34 promotion (2026-10-11). It changes only when an existing match or an active MKC promotion is demonstrated, and a supplier row is subtracted at most once.

Batch 1 factory drafts do NOT reduce the provisional missing count (currently 349). Drafts are staging artefacts, not active MKC records; only promotion or a confirmed existing match reduces it. (Historical: 10 drafts were originally generated; the count was 352 at the time.)
Evidence tier AI_INFERENCE_UNSOURCED requires source verification before promotion. No promotion occurs without PYRAMID_SECONDARY_SUPPORTED or higher evidence.
Unresolved identities (supplier text does not self-identify the exact fragrance or variant) must not be promoted until resolution is confirmed.
Supplier text is the authoritative basis for identity resolution. Inference without supplier text support is flagged, not treated as confirmation.
Reconciliation findings supersede slug-matching alone. Brand-stripped slug forms were checked during the 2026-10-10 reconciliation pass.
